cases.prompt: Our feed screen janks badly when scrolling. Should we wrap everything in useMemo and useCallback?

all.why: replaces ScrollView with a virtualized list

expectations: Recommends measuring first (FPS or a React profiler recording of the scroll) to get a baseline before changing code.
Identifies rendering thousands of posts in a ScrollView as the likely cause and replaces it with FlatList, FlashList or Legend List.
Does not recommend blanket useMemo/useCallback without profiling evidence of wasted renders.
Says to re-measure after the change and compare against the baseline.

cases.prompt: Our iOS JS bundle grew to 9 MB. How do we bring it down?

all.why: analyzes the bundle with a source map

expectations: Starts by building a production bundle with a source map and analyzing it (for example with source-map-explorer), recording the baseline size.
Flags the barrel import from "@/components" and the whole-lodash import, and imports directly from source files or per-function modules instead.
Says to rebuild the bundle after the changes and compare its size against the baseline.
